quantification_strategy: Relative MS signal intensities of dimethyl labeled peptides

acquisition: The MS methods included a full MS scan at a resolution of 70,000 followed by 10 data-dependent MS2 scans at a resolution of 17,500.
labeling: peptides from C_PACL and PACL were labeled with light (CH2O and NaBH3CN) and medium (CD2O and NaBH3CN) dimethyl labeling reagents
quantification: The Precursor Ions Quantifier node in Proteome Discoverer™ Software was employed to quantify the relative MS signal intensities of dimethyl labeled peptides.
workflow_hints: The protein mixtures were digested with trypsin
fixed modifications: carbamidomethylation of cysteine (+57.02146 Da), as well as light and medium dimethylation of N termini and lysine (+28.031300 and +32.056407 Da)

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used dimethyl labeling for relative quantification of proteins in P. aeruginosa biofilms. No specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or ubiquitin) was performed; the study focused on global proteomic expression changes.

scope: The 24-h biofilms of the parent P. aeruginosa (PACL) and Chlorhexidine-activated P. aeruginosa (C_PACL) were prepared in glass flasks and removed by cell scrapers. The biofilm pellets were collected by centrifugation at 4500 rpm at 4 °C for 30 min, mixed with 8 M urea, sonication, and determining protein concentrations (BCA assay).
The pellets were lysed with 8 M urea in 100 mM TEAB followed by sonication.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics was performed on total protein extracted from biofilm pellets (whole cell lysate of the sessile bacteria). No specific subcellular fractionation was performed prior to digestion.
